          python3 tests/world_save/run-cross-level.py --run-native --byond-bin "$PWD/BYOND/byond/bin" --byond-archive "$PWD/BYOND/pinned.zip" --case move-direct
          python3 tests/world_save/run-cross-level.py --run-native --byond-bin "$PWD/BYOND/byond/bin" --byond-archive "$PWD/BYOND/pinned.zip" --negative-control first-capture
          # Synthetic writer/reader only. No private save path or staging upload.
          if ! python3 tests/world_save/partial_save_inspector/inspect-partial-save.py --self-test-only --byond-bin "$PWD/BYOND/byond/bin" --byond-archive "$PWD/BYOND/pinned.zip"; then

            # a source save or runtime input. Bound diagnostics; do not upload logs.
            for log in "$HOME"/civ13-save-inspect-*/{writer,reader}-compile.log; do
